Z_div_mod_eq_full =
fun a b : Z =>
let s := Z.eq_dec b 0 in
match s with
| left e =>
    (fun e0 : b = 0%Z =>
     eq_ind_r (fun b0 : Z => a = (b0 * (a / b0) + a mod b0)%Z)
       match a as z return (z = (0 * (z / 0) + z mod 0)%Z) with
       | 0%Z => eq_refl
       | Z.pos p => (fun p0 : positive => eq_refl) p
       | Z.neg p => (fun p0 : positive => eq_refl) p
       end e0) e
| right n => (fun n0 : b <> 0%Z => Z.div_mod a b n0) n
end
     : forall a b : Z, a = (b * (a / b) + a mod b)%Z

Arguments Z_div_mod_eq_full (a b)%Z_scope
